blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several internet service providers (IPS) in the country are experiencing network issues and internet outages on Friday evening, Oct. 2. According to the University of the Philippines Diliman Network Helpdesk, one of the undersea cable segments between the Philippines and Singapore is reportedly offline. This caused disconnections and slow internet speeds in some platforms as most of the upstream IPS connect through these major information pipelines.
